**Panama Disease reference features:**

**Comparison:** The test image shows the early stage of the yellowing pattern that is characteristic of Panama Disease (Fusarium wilt) — diffuse leaf yellowing causing the leaf to droop. The reference confirms this progression: outer leaves turn yellow then develop brown streaks as the disease advances. Sigatoka would show discrete yellow/black lesions rather than uniform yellowing; Cordana Leaf Spot would show oval brown spots; Bunchy_Top would cause stunted bunchy growth at the top.

The uniform yellowing of a single hanging leaf, with the rest of the plant visible in the background, matches Panama Disease most strongly.
